profile.name: Muhammad Asad
profile.title: Data Engineer
profile.summary: Data Engineer building cloud-native ETL/ELT pipelines with Azure Data Factory, Databricks and PySpark. Designs Medallion Architecture lakehouses, uses Delta Live Tables, and enforces data governance with Unity Catalog. Strong foundation in data modeling, SQL and end-to-end analytics solutions.
profile.heroHeadline: Pipelines, models and tests for data you can trust.
profile.heroSupportingText: Azure Data Factory, Databricks, PySpark, dbt and Airflow, from ingestion to Power BI.

bullets: Creating a Central Data Repository in Microsoft Fabric to bring together data from each department.
Building ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest and integrate departmental data into the central repository.
Developed Python solutions for client requirements and independent projects.
Built and maintained application features and automation, resolving issues and refining solutions based on project needs.
Built and maintained Python-based ETL scripts for backend data handling, automation and internal tooling.
Developed and optimized internal data tools, improving pipeline efficiency, code maintainability and reliability.
Assisted in debugging, testing and deploying Python-based services using Git best practices.
Improved on-page search visibility through keyword research and optimization of page titles, meta descriptions, headings, and content.
Reviewed page structure, internal links, and URLs and used search performance insights to guide optimization work.

projects.title: NYC Taxi End-to-End Data Engineering
bullets: Cloud ETL/ELT pipeline orchestrated with Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2 as the data lake, Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
PySpark on Azure Databricks with Delta Lake for ACID transactions and time travel.
Databricks-to-Data Lake access secured with an Azure Service Principal; data quality validated across layers; curated data visualized in Power BI.

projects.title: Netflix Azure End-to-End Data Engineering
bullets: Parameterized ADF pipelines ingesting from HTTP/REST APIs into a Medallion lakehouse.
Databricks Autoloader for incremental ingestion; PySpark for schema casting and window-function transformations.
Gold-layer pipelines with Delta Live Tables and data quality Expectations; governance through Unity Catalog.

projects.title: Spotify Azure End-to-End Data Engineering
bullets: Dynamic ADF pipelines with backfilling, moving data from Azure SQL Database to an ADLS Gen2 lakehouse.
Spark Structured Streaming with Autoloader and SCD Type 2 logic via Delta Live Tables.
Jinja-templated, metadata-driven SQL views; Logic Apps failure alerts; Databricks Asset Bundles for CI/CD.

projects.title: Walmart Data Engineering Pipeline
bullets: ELT pipeline structured as Bronze/Silver/Gold using PostgreSQL, dbt and Airflow.
dbt models producing Silver business entities (customer, order, product, employee) and Gold fact and dimension tables.
Containerized Airflow DAGs that use the Databricks SDK to trigger a Databricks ingestion job.

projects.title: Flight Delay Prediction Pipeline
bullets: Medallion pipeline on BTS On-Time Performance data (10.5M+ flight records) with dbt-databricks and a self-determining incremental ingestion notebook that loads only missing months.
Gold star schema with SCD2 snapshots for airport and carrier dimensions; Dockerized Airflow DAGs with dbt snapshot/run/test and failure alerting.
Two consumers of the Gold layer: a FastAPI + LLM text-to-SQL agent with a Streamlit UI, and a Power BI DirectQuery dashboard.

projects.title: Merit Order ETL Pipeline
bullets: Bronze/Silver/Gold pipeline tracking plant-wise fuel costs on Pakistan's power grid from NTDC Merit Order reports; PDF links extracted from the source site's compiled Angular JS bundle.
Databricks ai_parse_document OCR for scanned report tables into a structured 8-column schema, then PySpark and Delta Lake validation and cost calculations in Silver.
Chained Databricks Job (Ingestion, Transformation, Insights) with per-fuel-type IQR outlier detection in Gold, separating market-wide cost shocks from plant-specific anomalies.
